fee_notes: Royalty is greater of 4% of Gross Monthly Revenues or minimum monthly fee (scales by territory size and month: $0-$6,750). National Ad Fund 0.75% of gross revenue. Additional $1,800/mo minimum for marketing new commercial accounts. Placement fee 8% of unit franchise sale proceeds.
